description: Trace a full circle with the CoreXY gantry around a given center (X, Y) position with a given radius, using trapezoidal acceleration over the whole lap. Moves to the circle start point first. Requires a prior Calibrate Gantry XY run. Errors and stops immediately if the circle does not fit the workspace or a limit switch is hit.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that drives the CoreXY gantry.

inputs.label: Center X (cm)
inputs.description: Absolute X position of the circle center in cm. 0 is the safe X-min end (5 mm off the switch); the max is the X track length minus the 5 mm buffer at each end. The whole circle must also fit inside this range.

inputs.label: Center Y (cm)
inputs.description: Absolute Y position of the circle center in cm. 0 is the safe Y-min end (5 mm off the switch); the max is the Y track length minus the 5 mm buffer at each end. The whole circle must also fit inside this range.

inputs.label: Radius (cm)
inputs.description: Circle radius in cm. The whole circle must fit inside the calibrated workspace.

inputs.label: Repeat Count
inputs.description: Number of full circles to trace before continuing.

inputs.label: Move Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric target motor speed for the circle move.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Ramp acceleration and deceleration over the whole circle instead of jumping straight to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin reserved for a Y maximum limit switch. This machine has no Y-max switch wired; the pin is held inactive by its pull-up and never blocks a move. The usable Y range is bounded by the Y track length and the 5 mm buffers instead.

outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: Continue when the circle move completes.

firmware_requirements.protocol: Serial commands: SET XY PINS, SET XY ENABLE, SET XY LIMITS, CIRCLEXY <centerXCm> <centerYCm> <radiusCm> <rpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond>. The backend sends CIRCLEXY once per requested repeat. Firmware moves to the circle start point, then traces the circle in short chords using the calibrated steps-per-cm restored from NVS, with one trapezoidal ramp across each lap, and faults on workspace or limit violations.
firmware_requirements.description: Firmware routine required by the Move Gantry Circle block.
